run_experiment_PIMH: run a PIMH evaluation experiment using the run_experiment function with a config object
run_experiment_MCMC: run a final target density MCMC experiment using run_experiment with evaluation_algo set to mcmc_final
create_particle_propose: create a particle propose function for SMC, CRAFT, or VI algorithms using get_particle_propose
create_expectation_logger: create an ExpectationLogger instance to compute and log expectations based on particle states
update_moving_average: update an OnlineMovingAverage instance with a new value and retrieve the running average
